raw_text:
Below is a 12-week, back-friendly general strength program designed for a 42-year-old male desk worker with history of L4–L5 herniation (now asymptomatic). It avoids heavy spinal loading and loaded spinal flexion, emphasizes neutral spine, hip hinging proficiency, core stability, and progressive overload without axial barbell loading. It uses machines, cables, dumbbells, and bodyweight where appropriate. Three sessions per week (e.g., Mon/Wed/Fri). Each week includes a mobility/warm-up, main lifts, accessories, core, conditioning/finishers, and recovery guidelines.

Global principles
- No heavy axial loading: avoid back squats, barbell deadlifts from floor, overhead barbell presses. Use goblet, landmine, trap-bar from blocks if light/moderate only, machines, split-stance variations, and sled.
- No loaded spinal flexion: no sit-ups, crunches, toe-touch with load, Jefferson curls. Core trained with anti-flexion/anti-rotation/anti-extension.
- Neutral spine, bracing, hip hinge with dowel cue. Tempo control: 2–3s eccentrics early on.
- Pain rule: 0–2/10 acceptable during, no increase after, and no next-day flare. If pain appears, stop the movement and swap for a safer variant.
- Progression: increase load 2–5% or 1–2 reps weekly if all sets at RPE 6–7 are achieved, deloads as programmed.
- RPE targets: early phases RPE 6–7, later RPE 7–8, never grinding.

Session template (all phases)
1) Prep (8–12 min)
- Breathing: 90/90 diaphragmatic breathing x 5 breaths
- Segmental cat-camel (gentle, unloaded) x 5 each
- Hip flexor half-kneeling stretch 45s/side
- Hamstring sliding floss (neutral spine) x 8/side
- T-spine open books x 6/side
- Glute activation: side-lying clamshell miniband x 12/side; glute bridge x 12
- Ankle rocks and shoulder CARs x 5
2) Movement prep sets: 1–2 light sets for first 2 main lifts

Phase overview
- Phase 1 (Weeks 1–3): Re-groove movement, build capacity, core stability, introduce machines/DB work. RPE 6–7.
- Phase 2 (Weeks 4–6): Progress volume and unilateral strength; moderate loads, strict tempo. RPE 6–7.5.
- Phase 3 (Weeks 7–9): Intensify compound patterns without axial stress; introduce power (med ball), sled work. RPE 7–8.
- Phase 4 (Weeks 10–12): Consolidate strength, small performance push, taper in week 12 testing via rep PRs on safe lifts. RPE 7–8.

Key exercise pool (spine-friendly)
- Knee-dominant: leg press (neutral pelvis), hack sled (light/mod), belt squat (if available), step-up, split squat variants, sled push.
- Hip-dominant: Romanian deadlift (DB/KB trap-bar from blocks), hip thrust, cable pull-through, 45° back extension (neutral spine; short ROM), good-morning excluded.
- Upper push: DB bench (flat/incline), machine chest press, cable press, landmine press (if tolerated), push-ups (elevated).
- Upper pull: chest-supported row, cable row, lat pulldown/assisted pull-up, single-arm cable row.
- Core: dead bug, bird dog, side plank, Pallof press, RKC plank, farmer’s carries (moderate load), suitcase carry (light-mod), anti-rotation chops/lifts.
- Power/conditioning: med ball chest pass/rotational throw (light, no trunk flexion), sled push/pull, bike/rower (upright posture).

Weekly structure
- 3 days: A (knee-dominant + horizontal push/pull + core), B (hip-dominant + vertical pull/landmine + core), C (unilateral lower + accessory upper + carries).
- Finishers: low-impact conditioning 8–15 min.
- Rest: 48h between similar lower sessions.

Phase 1: Weeks 1–3 (Foundation and Technique)
Intent: Groove hinge/squat patterns without spinal load; build core endurance; learn bracing and tempo. RPE ~6–7. Tempo 3–1–1 on many lifts.

Week 1
Session A
- Leg press (feet mid-stance, neutral spine): 3x10 @ RPE 6, 2–3s down
- DB bench press (flat): 3x10 @ RPE 6
- Chest-supported DB row: 3x10
- Cable half-kneeling Pallof press: 3x12/side
- Side plank: 3x20–30s/side
- Bike easy Z2: 10 min

Session B
- DB Romanian deadlift (DB RDL), DBs at thighs, hinge to mid-shin: 3x8 @ RPE 6 (neutral spine)
- Hip thrust (bar pad or DB across hips): 3x10
- Lat pulldown (neutral grip): 3x10
- Landmine press half-kneeling (light): 3x10/side (if any back discomfort, swap for machine shoulder press light)
- Bird dog: 3x8/side (5s holds)
- Farmer’s carry (moderate, short DBs): 4x20m, tall posture
- Rower Z2 upright: 8 min

Session C
- Elevated split squat (rear foot on floor, front foot on 2–3" plate if needed): 3x8/side
- Step-up (low box, controlled): 3x8/side
- Seated cable row (neutral): 3x10
- Incline DB bench: 3x10
- Dead bug (band-resisted arms optional): 3x8/side (3s exhale)
- Sled push light: 6x20m, walk-back rest

Week 2
- Add one set to first two main lifts each session (becomes 4 sets).
- Increase load 2–5% if all reps achieved, RPE ≤7.
- Core holds +5–10s per set; carries +5m per length.

Week 3
- Keep 4 sets on mains. Progress reps on mains to 11–12 if RPE allows, or small load bump.
- Introduce cable pull-through 3x12 in Session B after hip thrust (swap out one accessory if needed).
- Conditioning 12 min Z2.

Phase 2: Weeks 4–6 (Volume and Unilateral Emphasis)
Intent: Build strength endurance and joint control; increase unilateral lower work; reinforce core anti-rotation. RPE 6.5–7.5.

Week 4
Session A
- Belt squat or hack squat (light-moderate, neutral pelvis): 4x8
- DB bench press: 4x8 (slightly heavier)
- Chest-supported row: 4x8
- Pallof press iso hold: 3x20–30s/side
- Side plank with top-leg abduction: 3x20–30s/side
- Bike intervals easy: 6x45s Z3 / 75s Z1

Session B
- Trap-bar RDL from 4–6” blocks (not from floor): 4x6–8 @ RPE 7 (bar tracks close, spine neutral)
- Hip thrust: 4x8
- Neutral-grip pulldown or assisted pull-up: 4x6–8
- Half-kneeling landmine press: 3x8/side
- Bird dog row (light DB or cable): 3x8/side
- Suitcase carry light-moderate: 4x20–30m/side

Session C
- Rear-foot elevated split squat (RFESS), small elevation: 4x8/side
- Step-down (eccentric control): 3x8/side, 3s down
- Seated cable row single-arm: 3x10/side
- Push-up to elevated bar/box: 3xAMRAP leaving 2 reps in tank
- Dead bug with stability ball (hands/knees into ball): 3x8 breaths
- Sled push moderate: 6–8x20–30m

Week 5
- Progress loads 2–5% on mains if RPE ≤7.5.
- Add med ball chest pass (against wall) 3x6 in Session A pre-lifts.
- Add cable lift/chop (tall-kneeling) 3x10/side in Session C.

Week 6
- Keep volumes; aim for top of rep ranges (e.g., 8s on 6–8). Slight load bump if form pristine.
- Conditioning 12–15 min mixed (bike/rower), HR Z2–low Z3.

Phase 3: Weeks 7–9 (Intensification and Power)
Intent: Slightly heavier loads with clean technique, add safe power drills, maintain unilateral and core. RPE 7–8.

Week 7
Session A
- Belt squat or leg press (heavier): 5x5–6 @ RPE 7–7.5
- DB bench press (heavier): 4x6–8
- Chest-supported row: 4x6–8
- Med ball chest pass: 4x5 (fast, light)
- Pallof press step-out: 3x10/side
- Side plank row (cable): 3x8/side
- Bike: 8 min Z2 cooldown

Session B
- Trap-bar RDL from blocks: 5x5–6 @ RPE 7.5–8
- Barbell hip thrust or DB hip thrust: 4x6–8 (pause 1s at top)
- Neutral-grip pulldown: 4x6–8
- Single-arm landmine press: 3x6–8/side
- Bird dog with band resistance: 3x8/side
- Farmer’s carry heavier: 5x20–30m

Session C
- RFESS: 4x6–8/side (slightly heavier)
- Low box step-up (knee < hip height): 3x8/side, drive through heel
- Single-arm cable row: 3x8/side
- Incline DB bench: 3x8
- Anti-rotation hold (Pallof ISO): 3x25–35s/side
- Sled push heavy-moderate: 6x25–30m

Week 8
- Maintain sets; progress loads slightly if RPE ≤7.5 last week, aim RPE 7.5–8 on main lower lifts.
- Add med ball rotational throw 3x5/side in Session B warm-up if trunk rotation is pain-free and controlled (no flexion).
- Conditioning: 10x40s Z3 / 60s Z1 on bike or elliptical.

Week 9
- Keep intensity; reduce one accessory set per session to manage fatigue.
- Technique audit: video hinge and squat patterns; ensure no lumbar flexion in bottom positions.

Phase 4: Weeks 10–12 (Consolidation and Performance)
Intent: Solidify strength, slightly push performance with safe “rep PRs,” taper in week 12. RPE 7–8, no grinders.

Week 10
Session A
- Belt squat or leg press: 5x5 @ RPE 7.5–8
- DB bench press: 4x6 @ RPE 7.5
- Chest-supported row: 4x6
- Med ball chest pass: 4x4 (crisp)
- Pallof press: 3x10/side
- Side plank: 3x35–45s/side
- Bike Z2: 10–12 min

Session B
- Trap-bar RDL from blocks: 5x4–5 @ RPE 7.5–8
- Hip thrust: 4x5–6 (1–2s pause at top)
- Neutral-grip pulldown or assisted pull-up: 4x5–6
- Landmine press: 3x6/side
- Bird dog: 3x6/side (6s holds)
- Farmer’s carry heavy-moderate: 5x25–35m

Session C
- RFESS: 4x6/side (heavier)
- Step-down: 3x6/side (3s eccentric)
- Single-arm cable row: 3x8/side
- Incline DB bench: 3x6–8
- Anti-rotation chop/lift: 3x8/side
- Sled push moderate: 6x30m

Week 11
- Rep PR week (safe lifts): On belt squat/leg press, DB bench, hip thrust—select loads to beat Week 10 total reps by 1–2 per top set while staying ≤RPE 8.
- Keep hinge ROM strict; do not chase depth at expense of spine.
- Reduce conditioning volume by ~20% to recover.

Week 12 (Taper/test via AMRAP-within-form, not max)
- Reduce total volume ~30–40%; 2–3 working sets on mains; 1–2 sets on accessories; maintain core.
Session A
- Belt squat/leg press: Work up to 1 top set of 6–8 @ RPE ~8; optional AMRAP set at same load stopping 2 reps shy of failure.
- DB bench: 2x6–8 @ RPE 7; 1 AMRAP set leaving 1–2 reps in tank.
- Chest-supported row: 2x8 moderate
- Pallof press: 2x10/side
- 8 min Z2

Session B
- Trap-bar RDL from blocks: 3x4–5 @ RPE 7.5 (no AMRAP)
- Hip thrust: 2x6–8 @ RPE 7; 1 AMRAP leaving 1–2 reps
- Neutral pulldown: 2x6–8
- Landmine press: 2x6/side
- Farmer’s carry: 3x20–30m

Session C
- RFESS: 2x6/side @ RPE 7; optional AMRAP set per side leaving 1–2 reps
- Step-up: 2x8/side light
- Cable row single-arm: 2x8/side
- Core: side plank 2x30–40s/side; dead bug 2x8/side
- Light sled push: 4x20m

Technique and coaching notes
- Spine: Maintain neutral; cue “ribs down, brace 360°, tall chest without overextending.”
- Hinge: Dowel along head–thoracic–sacrum during practice; stop ROM when lumbar neutrality would be lost.
- Hip thrust: Posterior tilt slightly at top to avoid lumbar extension; shins vertical at peak.
- Leg press/belt squat: Do not posteriorly tilt pelvis at depth; choose foot position and depth maintaining lumbar neutrality.
- Rows/pulldowns: Pack shoulders, slight thoracic extension, no lumbar extension to finish the pull.
- Landmine press: Half-kneeling to limit lumbar extension; squeeze glute on trailing leg.
- Carries: Walk slow, tall posture; if any back discomfort, reduce load or swap to farmer hold.

Conditioning and mobility
- Conditioning 2–3x/week within sessions as written. Keep mostly Z2; one Z3 interval day in Phases 2–3.
- Daily micro-mobility (5–7 min): hip flexor stretch, glute bridge 2x12, cat-camel gentle 1x8, 90/90 breathing x5.
- Walking goal: 7–9k steps/day to reduce stiffness from desk work. Break sitting every 30–45 minutes.

Recovery
- Sleep: 7–9 hours; consistent schedule.
- RPE autoregulation: If waking stiffness/fatigue high or back niggle appears, reduce load 10–15% that day, cut a set, and emphasize core and mobility.
- Deload built into Week 12 volume reduction.

Optional nutrition guidance (general)
- Protein: 1.6–2.2 g/kg/day.
- Calories: maintenance to mild surplus (+150–250 kcal) to support strength gains if body comp allows.
- Hydration: 30–35 ml/kg/day; add 500–750 ml around training.
- Pre-training: carb + protein 60–90 min before (e.g., yogurt + fruit); post-training: 20–40 g protein within 2–3 h.

Red flags/when to refer back
- Reproduction of radicular symptoms, numbness/tingling, or back pain >3/10 lasting >24–48h: pause aggravating lifts, regress ROM, and consult physio.

This plan builds general strength without heavy spinal loading, emphasizes safe patterns, and provides clear weekly progressions and built-in checks to respect the L4–L5 history.
